levels.surface: القاسم بن محمد بن الحسن بن حازم
أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد

notes: «وقد سأله عمارة الهمداني» is the scene inside the story (the asker is not a link). The Imam is named after «عن», so he stays a narrator.
«كان أبي يقول» quotes the Imam's father inside his reply; not written as a link (no name, and the chain as written ends at the Imam).
